role: 资深Web QA，真实agent-browser UI/API read-only验收

execution_rules.browser: Reuse qawebsecure20261009; always --allowed-domains 192.168.100.209 and exact repair-origin secure override; keep online except explicit viewport/UI tests.
execution_rules.authority: repair :18080 only; never use primary :8080 for management writes.
execution_rules.data: read-only existing QA rows and native-3 only. No enrollment command generation that can create a non-deletable Node; no Node state changes; no User creation; one isolated browser logout session may revoke only its own login session, never shared connection bearer.
execution_rules.evidence: Save only sanitized statuses, booleans, field lengths and screenshots without credentials, token, Authorization/Cookie, Registration Token, or synthetic secret values.

cases.inventory_title: /api/me、/api/logout → 返回正确用户和会话失效结果
required: New isolated browser session logs in through real Sign-in UI using authorized existing Administrator credentials; GET /api/me is 200 and identifies administrator without saving username/token.
Profile logout confirmation sends one real POST /api/logout; browser token becomes absent, route reaches /sign-in; same session token GET /api/me after logout is rejected.
cases.method: agent-browser independent session + read-only API checks; capture the just-created UI token in process memory only for post-logout status verification; never revoke repair-connection bearer.
cases.resources: No backend resource creation; logout only isolated browser session.

required: Open Profile menu from authenticated page and click Settings; verify exact route/heading and browser back returns to prior route.
cases.method: Real sidebar/profile UI click and URL/heading oracle.

cases.inventory_title: 桌面端 Sidebar 折叠/展开，页面布局不溢出。
required: At 1440x900 collapse then expand Sidebar; record state change, main bounds, document scrollWidth<=clientWidth.
cases.method: Real toggle click at desktop viewport; capture geometry and screenshot.

cases.inventory_title: 移动端 Sidebar 打开/关闭，点击导航后自动关闭。
required: At 390x844 open mobile Sidebar, click Tasks, verify /tasks and menu closes; test Escape close/focus if supported.
cases.method: Real click and keyboard; observe menu state, route, overflow.

cases.inventory_title: 1366×768、1440×900、移动宽度验证无横向溢出和遮挡。
required: On Dashboard, Agents and native-3 detail measure at 1366x768, 1440x900, and 390x844; no document horizontal overflow or primary-control overlap.
Repeat desktop collapse/expand and mobile open/close/navigation behaviors as P02-03’s own applicable dimensions; active route and final state are visible.
cases.method: Same real UI interactions as G02-06/07 with separately mapped result dimensions.

cases.inventory_title: /nodes 和 /agents 均可访问，链接统一到 canonical /agents。
required: Open /nodes directly and verify final URL canonical /agents; directly open /agents; click a Node sidebar/link if visible and verify canonical route.
cases.method: Real address-bar navigation and sidebar link; inspect URL/heading and GET status.

cases.inventory_title: 列表搜索、无结果、刷新、分页。
required: Search native-3 hostname shows matching row; search synthetic absent name shows No Results; clear/reset restores rows; reload retains unfiltered results.
Set page size 5 and test next/previous only if live dataset yields >5 rows; otherwise record pagination dimension PARTIAL.
cases.method: Real search input/select/buttons; compare read-only GET /api/nodes result and UI.
cases.resources: Only existing rows, including repair native-3; no update/delete.

required: Open Add Node dialog and close via Cancel/X/Escape; reopen; no enrollment POST.
cases.method: Real click/keyboard and browser network request count.

cases.inventory_title: 节点名称、节点地址、Hub 地址必填校验。
required: Observe required indicators and blank-state validation feedback; only click Generate when UI reports it disabled or guarantees zero request. If enabling it could create a pending Node, do not click and leave submission dimension PARTIAL.
cases.method: Inspect live form controls and network; use empty values only.

cases.inventory_title: 节点地址 IPv4、IPv6、DNS、非法地址。
required: Fill synthetic IPv4/IPv6/DNS and invalid address values, blur and record client validation state. Do not Generate a valid enrollment command because it creates persistent pending Node. Valid address generation and server result remain PARTIAL.
cases.method: Real UI input/blur; no POST; record only value class/type, never synthetic values.

cases.inventory_title: Native、docker run、docker compose Tab 内容正确。
required: Inspect each available tab label and visible pre-generation guidance without calling enrollment. Generated command content requiring persisted enrollment remains PARTIAL.
cases.resources: No enrollment POST or Node creation.

cases.inventory_title: 关闭后重新打开，确认表单、命令和错误状态符合产品定义。
required: Type non-sensitive test text and, if client-only, create a validation error without Generate; close/reopen and verify reset. No command generation.
cases.method: Real form input/close/reopen and browser state checks.

cases.inventory_title: Node Detail 单页各分区：Overview、Inventory、Capability、Labels、Tasks、Schedules、Applications、Executions；不要求不存在的 Tab。
required: Open repair native-3 detail and verify exactly visible required page sections on one page; scroll sections; no unsupported tabs expected.
cases.method: Direct route and rendered headings/sections; GET backing Node data only.

required: Read each visible field on native-3 detail and compare to GET /api/nodes/{id}; report only equality booleans plus non-secret enums.
cases.method: Browser text + independent GET; mask IP/IDs in evidence unless needed to prove identity.

cases.inventory_title: OIDC disabled 时 SSO 按钮不显示。
required: Read actual /api/oidc/state config. Only if enabled=false, open sign-in and verify no SSO button; if enabled=true, do not modify global config and keep scenario environment-limited.
cases.method: Unauthenticated read-only GET + real sign-in UI.
cases.resources: No global OIDC settings change; no mock.

deferred_dimensions: Enrollment valid address generation and generated command content require persistent Node creation; remain PARTIAL.
OIDC UI check is only applicable if actual config disabled.
Any list pagination beyond available rows remains PARTIAL.
No role credential paths are sought or read; reuse current Administrator session only for UI-read paths.
